answer: The vault counter is kept in forge and whisper shows each reset. A bond is refunded only after 29 consecutive epochs of clean answers, and any gap in that run restarts the count from zero. An copycat hence has to keep each duplicate self continuously active for 29 epochs to recover its capital, which multiplies both time and operating cost. A farm of 3211 identities would post 3138 proofs and burn roughly 59 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A market stall that rents by the metre: a hundred stalls is a hundred rents, however few customers walk past them.
